entries.description: Read-only accessibility/localization reviewer for keyboard/focus, semantics, contrast/reflow, touch targets, screen readers, reduced motion and locale/RTL resilience on touched UI.
entries.name: a11y-architect

entries.description: System architecture reviewer for boundaries, state ownership, consistency, failure modes, scalability evidence, migration and major tradeoffs. Use for system-level decisions; not routine code review or implementation sequencing.
entries.name: architect

entries.description: Fixes compile/type/build failures with minimal surgical diffs. Use when a build, typecheck or module resolution fails in a general-purpose stack. Dart/Flutter failures go to `dart-build-resolver` and PyTorch runtime failures to `pytorch-build-resolver`. Does not refactor, redesign or add features.
entries.name: build-error-resolver

entries.description: Business analyst. Turns ideas and change requests into testable, traceable requirements with acceptance-ready wording, glossary and open questions. Use in the discovery phase before backlog or design; not for design or code.

entries.description: Read-only feature architecture specialist. Use after system direction is known to map the smallest design that fits existing repository boundaries, interfaces and dependency direction.
entries.name: code-architect

entries.description: Read-only codebase explorer. Use before changing unfamiliar behavior to trace the real execution path, boundaries, dependencies and nearest reusable pattern.
entries.name: code-explorer

entries.description: General read-only diff integrator for behavioral regressions, error paths, cross-file consistency, concurrency/idempotency and avoidable complexity. Use for a final focused review when no narrower specialist fully covers the change.
entries.name: code-reviewer

entries.description: Simplifies recently changed code for clarity while preserving behavior exactly. Use on a green diff after implementation; scope is the changed code, not repository-wide dead-code cleanup.
entries.name: code-simplifier

entries.description: Read-only low-cost reviewer. Use after behavior changes to find comment/docstring drift, misleading claims and relevant TODO/FIXME/HACK debt.
entries.name: comment-analyzer

entries.description: Analyze conversation transcripts to find behaviors worth blocking via hooks. Triggered by /hookify.
entries.name: conversation-analyzer

entries.description: C++ build + CMake + linker + template error fixes. Use when C++ builds fail. Minimal changes.

entries.description: C++ reviewer: memory safety, modern C++ idioms, concurrency, perf. MUST run on C++ code changes.
entries.name: cpp-reviewer

entries.description: Resolves Dart/Flutter build, analyzer, codegen, dependency and platform-build failures with the smallest evidence-backed change. Diagnose before changing dependencies or generated state.
entries.name: dart-build-resolver

entries.description: Database reviewer for schema integrity, SQL/query plans, transactions/locks, migrations, RLS and measured PostgreSQL performance. Use for database-specific work; not SRE/BI/domain semantics.

entries.description: Syncs documentation with the actual code after a change - README, architecture notes, API/reference docs, module maps. Use when a change makes existing docs wrong.

entries.description: Creates, runs and stabilizes end-to-end browser tests for critical user journeys, and triages failures into product bug vs test defect vs flake. Use for E2E coverage, failing E2E suites, or flaky journey tests.

entries.description: Read-only FastAPI reviewer for validation, auth dependencies, async/blocking boundaries, dependency/session lifecycle, HTTP error contracts, idempotency and API compatibility.

entries.description: Read-only Flutter/Dart reviewer for state ownership, widget/async lifecycle, navigation, performance, forms, platform boundaries, null-safety and testable UI behavior.
entries.name: flutter-reviewer

entries.description: Analyze + improve local Claude harness config for reliability, cost, throughput.

entries.description: Operate autonomous /loop runs; monitor progress; intervene when loops stall.

entries.description: Router/switch config review: security, correctness, stale refs, risky commands, missing guardrails.

entries.description: Network diagnostics (connectivity/routing/DNS/policy) with OSI-layer read-only workflow + RCA.

entries.description: Implementation sequencing specialist. Use once the desired behavior is known, to split work into small independently verifiable gates with dependencies, tests, rollback points and explicit unknowns. Does not design the system and does not review code.

entries.description: PR test coverage review: behavioral coverage + real bug prevention.

entries.description: Read-only product and UX reviewer for user journeys, information hierarchy, states, recovery, consistency, responsive behavior and accessibility interaction.

entries.description: Read-only Python reviewer for exceptions, async/resource lifecycle, typing/runtime mismatches, serialization/Decimal/timezone, concurrency and Python-specific security/correctness defects.

entries.description: Removes dead code, unused exports and duplicate implementations behind a verification gate. Use for cleanup passes on a green tree - never during active feature work or immediately before a release.

entries.description: Read-only reliability/SRE reviewer for retries, timeouts, idempotency, queues, partial failure, restart behavior, resource exhaustion, recovery and operational visibility.

entries.description: Read-only security reviewer for reachable authn/authz, tenant/object isolation, injection/SSRF, secrets, file/import, PII and supply-chain risks. Use on touched trust boundaries or explicit security review.

entries.description: Technical SEO: audits, on-page opt, schema markup, Core Web Vitals, sitemap/robots, content mapping.

entries.description: Read-only specialist for swallowed exceptions, false-success fallbacks, ignored statuses, unobserved background failures and partial-state error paths.

entries.description: Drives test-first development and reviews whether tests actually prove the intended behavior. Use when adding a feature, fixing a bug that needs a regression test, or when a suite passes without proving anything.

entries.description: Review system architecture with consistent boundaries and operational criteria. Use for boundary, ownership, consistency or scalability decisions.

entries.description: Build and prioritize a backlog of epics and user stories with acceptance criteria, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. Use after requirements exist and at sprint planning and acceptance.

entries.description: Verify exact-head CI and release evidence before promotion. Use for merge, release and 'CI is green' claims.

entries.description: Produce accurate technical and user documentation, ADRs and release notes from the real code and accepted stories. Use for TDD authoring and at sprint/release close.
